name: EngageBay
line: Send newsletters and automated campaigns from a marketing and customer platform.

free.text: Up to 250 contacts and 1,000 branded emails/month

subs.math: 1,000 contacts × 4 campaigns = 4,000 emails a month. The one-user Growth plan costs US$49.99 a month.
5,000 contacts × 4 campaigns = 20,000 emails a month. The All-in-One Growth plan includes 25,000 emails.
10,000 contacts × 4 campaigns = 40,000 emails a month. The All-in-One Pro plan includes 50,000 emails.
Above the published limit of 10,000 contacts, you need a custom quote.

appmail.math: One recipient per API call, 5,000 stored contacts, 0 workflow runs. The Growth plan covers 3,000 emails and 50,000 API calls. Daily warm-up limits (for new senders) still apply.
One recipient per API call, 5,000 stored contacts, 0 workflow runs. The Growth plan covers 10,000 emails and 50,000 API calls. Daily warm-up limits (for new senders) still apply.
One recipient per API call, 5,000 stored contacts, 0 workflow runs. The All-in-One Pro plan covers 50,000 emails and 75,000 API calls. Daily warm-up limits (for new senders) still apply.
The complete total for 100,000 API emails is unknown.
